title: TAT-3632 — before/after: the same live account state, two code versions
description: Demonstrates the defect rather than describing it. Captures the Perps account state from the running extension (streamed WebSocket cache vs the fresh account-state read the provider validates against), then feeds that one captured state to the real usePerpsWithdrawInsufficientBalanceAlert hook twice: once as it is on main (bc55c67781, pre-fix) and once as it is on this branch (post-fix). The driver file is byte-identical across both runs and asserts only the user-facing invariant — a withdrawal well under the balance the account really holds must not be blocked — so it FAILS on the pre-fix hook and PASSES on the post-fix hook. Preconditions: Extension runtime reachable over CDP on the slot port, wallet fixture unlocked, Perps provider reachable with a non-zero withdrawable balance on the selected account (testnet Hyperliquid, Account 1), and a clean git working tree (the pre-fix leg temporarily swaps one file and restores it).

setup-status.intent: Resolve the Extension checkout and adapter status before the proof

setup-cdp.intent: Confirm the Extension CDP runtime is reachable

setup-unlock.intent: Ensure the fixture-backed wallet is unlocked

setup-assert-clean-tree.intent: Refuse to run if the hook is already modified, so the pre-fix swap can always be restored

setup-leave-perps.intent: Read from a non-Perps screen, where nothing re-subscribes the streamed account channel

ab-capture-live-state.intent: Restart the UI realm (MV3-restart equivalent) and capture both balance sources read-only from the live extension

ab-assert-streamed-cache-empty.intent: The streamed cache really is empty after the restart — the condition the ticket describes

ab-assert-live-diverges.intent: The two sources disagree in the live runtime, so the choice of source is decidable

ab-run-prefix-hook.cmd: set -x; cp temp/tasks/fix/45191-0812-105020/artifacts/ab/perpsWithdrawFreshBalanceAB.driver.ts ui/pages/confirmations/hooks/alerts/transactions/perpsWithdrawFreshBalanceAB.test.ts && git show bc55c67781:ui/pages/confirmations/hooks/alerts/transactions/usePerpsWithdrawInsufficientBalanceAlert.ts > ui/pages/confirmations/hooks/alerts/transactions/usePerpsWithdrawInsufficientBalanceAlert.ts; AB_LABEL=pre-fix AB_COMMIT=bc55c67781 AB_INPUT=$PWD/temp/tasks/fix/45191-0812-105020/artifacts/ab/live-input.json AB_OUTPUT=$PWD/temp/tasks/fix/45191-0812-105020/artifacts/ab/prefix-observed.json yarn jest ui/pages/confirmations/hooks/alerts/transactions/perpsWithdrawFreshBalanceAB.test.ts --no-coverage --json --outputFile=temp/tasks/fix/45191-0812-105020/artifacts/ab/prefix-jest.json; rm -f ui/pages/confirmations/hooks/alerts/transactions/perpsWithdrawFreshBalanceAB.test.ts; git checkout HEAD -- ui/pages/confirmations/hooks/alerts/transactions/usePerpsWithdrawInsufficientBalanceAlert.ts
ab-run-prefix-hook.intent: BEFORE: run the identical driver against main's pre-fix hook. Expected to fail — that failure is the bug

ab-assert-tree-restored.intent: The pre-fix swap and the temporary driver file were both cleaned up

ab-assert-prefix-test-failed.intent: BEFORE: the invariant test fails on the pre-fix hook

ab-assert-prefix-blocked.intent: BEFORE: the pre-fix hook blocks a withdrawal the account can actually cover

ab-assert-prefix-alert-copy.intent: BEFORE: and it tells the user their funds are insufficient when they are not

ab-assert-prefix-read-streamed.intent: BEFORE: because it read the streamed cache, which the restart left empty

ab-run-postfix-hook.cmd: cp temp/tasks/fix/45191-0812-105020/artifacts/ab/perpsWithdrawFreshBalanceAB.driver.ts ui/pages/confirmations/hooks/alerts/transactions/perpsWithdrawFreshBalanceAB.test.ts; AB_LABEL=post-fix AB_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) AB_INPUT=$PWD/temp/tasks/fix/45191-0812-105020/artifacts/ab/live-input.json AB_OUTPUT=$PWD/temp/tasks/fix/45191-0812-105020/artifacts/ab/postfix-observed.json yarn jest ui/pages/confirmations/hooks/alerts/transactions/perpsWithdrawFreshBalanceAB.test.ts --no-coverage --json --outputFile=temp/tasks/fix/45191-0812-105020/artifacts/ab/postfix-jest.json; status=$?; rm -f ui/pages/confirmations/hooks/alerts/transactions/perpsWithdrawFreshBalanceAB.test.ts; exit $status
ab-run-postfix-hook.intent: AFTER: run the identical driver, on the identical captured state, against this branch's hook

ab-assert-postfix-test-passed.intent: AFTER: the same invariant test passes — and exactly one case ran, so the pass is not an empty filter

ab-assert-postfix-allowed.intent: AFTER: the valid withdrawal is allowed

ab-assert-postfix-read-fresh.intent: AFTER: because it read the fresh account state the provider validates against

ab-assert-postfix-ignores-streamed.intent: AFTER: and it never consults the streamed singleton at all

evidence-open-perps.intent: Show the real account balance the fresh read resolves to

evidence-wait-for-balance.intent: The account balance readout must be on screen before it is captured as evidence

evidence-kill-orphan-capture-helpers.intent: Clear orphaned capture-helper sessions so the screenshot cannot silently fall back to Page.captureScreenshot

evidence-screenshot-live-balance.label: The live Perps balance both hook versions were given
evidence-screenshot-live-balance.intent: Orientation: the account really does hold the balance the pre-fix hook denied
